posts.zh:
dsh-vision-fallback 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。将聊天图片交给固定的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，把事实性观察交给当前主模型，并在事件回放、上下文压缩和重启时复用会话内观察。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f9a50565c806307b0ba8.html
posts.en:
dsh-vision-fallback is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Routes chat images to a fixed OpenAI-compatible vision model, returns factual observations to the selected main model, and reuses session-scoped observations across replay, compaction, and restarts.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f9a50565c806307b0ba8.html
